mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID /* 회원아이디 */ , EXPERIENCE_CD /* 운동경력코드 */ , LEVEL_CD /* 운동레벨코드 */ , EQUIPMENT_CD /* 보유장비코드 */ , HEIGHT /* 키 */ , WEIGHT /* 체중 */ , GOAL_WEIGHT /* 목표체중 */ , GYM_ID /* 헬스장아이디 */ , SQUAT_YN /* 스쿼트가능여부 */ , BENCH_PRESS_YN /* 벤치프레스가능여부 */ , REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , MOD_DT /* 변경일시 */ FROM USER_FITNESS_PROFILE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_FITNESS_PROFILE SET EXPERIENCE_CD = COALESCE(#{dto.experienceCd}, EXPERIENCE_CD) , LEVEL_CD = COALESCE(#{dto.levelCd}, LEVEL_CD) , EQUIPMENT_CD = COALESCE(#{dto.equipmentCd}, EQUIPMENT_CD) , HEIGHT = COALESCE(#{dto.height, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, HEIGHT) , WEIGHT = COALESCE(#{dto.weight, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, WEIGHT) , GOAL_WEIGHT = COALESCE(#{dto.goalWeight, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_WEIGHT) , GYM_ID = COALESCE(#{dto.gymId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GYM_ID) , SQUAT_YN = COALESCE(#{dto.squatYn}, SQUAT_YN) , BENCH_PRESS_YN = COALESCE(#{dto.benchPressYn}, BENCH_PRESS_YN) , MOD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
